newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee under 35.75 barrier as RBI backs off.
newsitem.headline: India rupee under 35.75 barrier as RBI backs off.

text.p: The Indian rupee broke under the 35.75 per dollar barrier in noon trade as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) backed off from the spot market after intervening earlier, dealers said.
In latest deals, the rupee was quoted 35.7475/7525.

"It looks like the market is testing the RBI's resolve," said a dealer. "No one is taking positions aggressively but the market is definitely waiting to see if the RBI will buy dollars to prevent further rupee appreciation.
Dealers said the RBI bought dollars in limited amounts in morning trade when the rupee first moved through 35.75. The morning intervention pushed the rupee down after it hit 35.745, dealers said.
"But the RBI has been off the market since then," said a dealer. "Supplies are good and the rupee has moved up again."
Dealers said the central bank bought June and August delivery dollars in small lots in the forward market.
